name: Butinazocine
summary: Butinazocine (INN) is an opioid analgesic of the benzomorphan family which was never marketed.

uses.text: Butinazocine (INN) is an opioid analgesic of the benzomorphan family which was never marketed.

pharmacology.en: Like other benzomorphan opioids, it acts on opioid receptors. Drugs of this family often act on the kappa receptor as well as the mu receptor, which is why many of them cause unpleasant mental effects.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他苯并嗎啡烷類鴉片藥物一樣，它作用於鴉片受體。這個家族的藥物常同時作用於 kappa 與 μ 受體，這也是其中許多會造成不適精神作用的原因。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他苯并吗啡烷类鸦片药物一样，它作用于鸦片受体。这个家族的药物常同时作用于 kappa 与 μ 受体，这也是其中许多会造成不适精神作用的原因。

sideEffects.en: It was never marketed, so its effects in people are not documented. Opioids of the benzomorphan family can cause drowsiness, nausea, dizziness and, in some cases, hallucinations and confusion.
sideEffects.zh: 它從未上市，因此對人體的作用沒有紀錄。苯并嗎啡烷類鴉片藥物可能造成嗜睡、噁心、頭暈，有些情況下還會出現幻覺與混亂。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它从未上市，因此对人体的作用没有纪录。苯并吗啡烷类鸦片药物可能造成嗜睡、恶心、头晕，有些情况下还会出现幻觉与混乱。

fact.en: It belongs to the benzomorphans, a family in which chemists cut two of morphine's five rings away while keeping the painkilling action. It was never marketed.
fact.zh: 它屬於苯并嗎啡烷類，在這個家族中化學家把嗎啡五個環中的兩個去掉，卻保留了止痛作用。它從未上市。
fact.zhHans: 它属于苯并吗啡烷类，在这个家族中化学家把吗啡五个环中的两个去掉，却保留了止痛作用。它从未上市。
